continuity.campaign_development: March 60 BCE: Valerius entered the bandit-controlled interior using intelligence recovered from captured watching posts. The information was used to bypass a watched road, locate a hidden supply point, avoid a searched camp, and capture another watching position without a pitched battle. Intelligence rose to 939, supply recovered to 49, exhaustion rose to 52, relations fell to 98, and technology rose to 85.
